visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-bleed banner with a muted, autoplaying, looping background video (Vimeo/YouTube/MP4 link in the text) behind a right-aligned headline
visualCharacteristics.summary: Tall full-bleed banner with autoplay muted looping background video, grey overlay, light-weight white H1 right-aligned at about 40% width, red accent bar below

contentPattern.structure: row 1 = optional background image (UE fields image + imageAlt), used as poster/fallback; row 2 = rich text (UE field text) with the H1 and a paragraph containing a link to the background video (Vimeo, YouTube or .mp4). The link is removed from view and replaced by a muted, autoplaying, looping background video
contentPattern.source: get_block_details /block-collection/hero and blocks/hero/_hero.json (model fields image, imageAlt, text)

cells: Block name plus variant, e.g. Hero (video)
Rich text (field text): heading or statement, subheading, CTA link; the background-video URL as a link for the video variants

usage: Top-of-page brand banner with background video.
reuseGuidance: Use when the banner background is a video. For a static photo background use hero-promo.
